missionPremise: OPS-19 A-025 (served facet set is part of the publish contract), card E (the projection), A-021 (standing production word). Model law: 19_the_instrument_contract (every verdict names the scope it searched and the authority it found; absent, zero, and unmeasured are three states), ENFORCEMENT (never default a field whose correct value is unknown; a meaning-shaped check has two independently derived inputs; state the mechanism and the rejected alternative), _blueprint/40_rule_register (BP-SERVE-01, BP-SERVE-02, BP-CONFORMANT-01, BP-CONTENT-01).

premiseCorrections.claimInCard: the conformant assemble never mapped situsCity from the claim
premiseCorrections.finding: The assembly (nodeFacetTier1Assemble.ts) and the conformant builder (nodeFacetBakeTier1Conformant.ts line 264, present since f4710c69) DO map situsCity: `situsCity: claim.situsCity`. What dropped it is the claim READER: readConformantCadClaim read situsCity, situsZip, landAcres and propertyUseCode from `body.claim.*` only (with a body-root fallback for situsAddress and sourceIdentifiers alone), and the atoms store holds NO `body.claim`: the Factory's stage E (hauska-factory src/stages/write/index.mjs `stageRows`: `{ ...c, atomId, atomDid, ... }`) spreads the six-field candidate, so the claim fields sit at the body root beside provenance/confidence/citation/time/access with a minted `nodeId` (nid_...). 120 of 120 sampled conformant bodies across the six counties have no `claim` key; body_keys are [access, accessRestampRunId, accessRestampedAt, accessRestampedFrom, assessedValue, centroid, citation, confidence, countyFips, improvementValue, kind, landAcres, landValue, legalDescription, livingAreaSqft, logicVersion, marketValue, nodeId, ownerName, propertyUseCode, provenance, shape, situsAddress, situsCity, situsZip, sourceIdentifiers, time, yearBuilt].
premiseCorrections.mechanism: placement mismatch between the Factory's flat six-field body and the bake's nested-claim reader; situsAddress survived only because that one field had a root fallback
premiseCorrections.rejectedAlternative: the claim itself is null on the store (the first sample read `body->'claim'->>'situsCity'` and returned null for all 120, which looked like that); rejected by the second read of the same 120 rows at the root: situsCity populated on 82 of 120 (48021 3, 48055 15, 48209 17, 48309 19, 48453 8, 48491 20) and on all five golds (AUSTIN 78756, TAYLOR 76574, KYLE 78640, BASTROP 78602, BASTROP 78602)

premiseCorrections.claimInCard: card E: the bake projects land use from the claim's propertyUseCode and declared acreage from landAcres
premiseCorrections.finding: Same defect, wider than the card's scope: on production 0 of 1,498,010 conformant tier 1 rows carry a baseFacts.landUse object and 0 carry acreage with method cad-roll-land-acres (every acreage present is shoelace from the txgio ring). The fixture card E tested used the nested `body.claim` shape, which the store never had. The reader fix in this card (one claim record: body.claim when present, else the body) restores all four fields on the next re-bake; landUse was already measured absent by the walk only as a present-with-explicit-null key, which BP-CONTENT-01 accepts by design.
premiseCorrections.consequence: the six re-bakes after this card carry situsCity, situsZip, landUse and declared acreage; until then the served baseFacts are null on those four fields for every conformant parcel

premiseCorrections.claimInCard: the honest answer for the central Austin gold is that its zoning stamp is missing (stamp-missing for Austin) after the card
premiseCorrections.finding: The three unstamped golds hold the 0,0 bake coordinate sentinel (48453:493738 join no-row; 48491:76149 and 48209:135570 join gate-blocked: the county prop_id join is refused for Williamson and Hays), so loadCityLimitsFact returns unmeasured for lack of a query point and the served verdict after this card is `unmeasured` (no usable parcel query point), not `stamp-missing`. Production already serves cityLimitsFact.status unmeasured for those three (live read 19:56Z). `stamp-missing for Austin` needs a query point the bake does not hold for a no-row or gate-blocked parcel; that is filed as a follow-up (a point source other than the txgio join). Across the six, 534,700 unstamped conformant rows hold the sentinel and 667,497 hold a point.
premiseCorrections.consequence: after this card those 534,700 serve `unmeasured` with the reason; the 667,497 with a point serve stamp-missing (inside a place) or not-applicable (outside every place, county unzoned) by containment; none serve unincorporated from a null

followUpFromCp1: 534,700 unstamped conformant rows (and 376,109 of those in the two gate-blocked counties) hold the 0,0 coordinate sentinel; after this card they serve `unmeasured`. A query point from a source other than the txgio join is needed for stamp-missing / not-applicable to be stated for them.

Hays and Williamson: every parcel is unstamped because the prop_id join is gate-blocked; `stamp-missing` there is honest about the served payload but the cause is the refused join (unmeasured stamp, not absent stamp). Consider carrying provenance.parcelJoin.state into the verdict basis.
Land use and declared acreage are null on all 1,498,010 rows for the same reader defect; the six re-bakes after this card restore them.
